_comment: Parasite (2019) shot catalogue. Stage 2 ACT 1 ONLY (infiltration, 0:00-0:45). Acts 2-3 to be catalogued next session. Every shot frame-verified (frames/verify/act1/). Cut-aware windows (real continuous takes, NOT 5s placeholders - Phase B lesson). Romanized names per names.json. depicts vocabulary per TAGGING_GUIDE. Muc 3 capacity fields auto-populated by catalogue.py enrich_shots.

shots.action: the film opens on socks drying at a half-buried window, the street outside at eye level - the Kims live with the gutter (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:00:50 - opening title shot)

Ki-woo holds his phone up hunting for free wifi while the family sits in the cramped semi-basement - the Kims' poverty established (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:01:50; nudged later to avoid opening-credit text overlay)
the whole Kim family folds pizza boxes for piece-work money in the cramped semi-basement (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:03:55)
a drunk relieves himself against their window; the family can only watch, powerless even in their own home (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:05:00)
street fumigation gas drifts into the open basement window; the family lets it in to kill the bugs - the gutter-level life (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:06:00)
Ki-woo's friend Min gives the family a 'scholar's rock' (viewing stone) said to bring wealth - opening the wooden box (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:07:18)
the scholar's rock, Min says, will cling to the family and bring them wealth - Ki-woo cannot stop holding it (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:08:10)
Min offers Ki-woo his tutoring job - teaching the rich Park family's daughter English while he studies abroad (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:08:50)
over street-stall soju, Min admits he is half in love with the girl Ki-woo will tutor, and trusts only Ki-woo not to pursue her (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:09:45)
Ki-jung forges a university enrolment document for Ki-woo on the laptop - the family's real talent is performance and deception (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:11:25)
Ki-jung's forgery is flawless - she jokes that she did not fake the document, she simply printed it (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:12:00)
Ki-woo climbs the concrete steps through the bamboo to the Parks' modernist house - the ascent into the other world (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:13:00)
inside, a clean bright staircase climbs upward - in the rich house the stairs always go up, toward more light (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:13:40 - vertical motif)
Ki-woo ('Kevin') interviews with Yeon-kyo, Mrs Park, in the bright glass-walled house overlooking the garden (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:14:30)
Mrs Park watches the lesson from the doorway, anxious and easily impressed, exactly the audience Ki-woo needs (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:15:20)
Ki-woo gives Da-hye her first English lesson, performing confidence as the qualified tutor (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:16:10)
Ki-woo's lesson with Da-hye is really a performance of swagger; the teenage girl is visibly charmed by her new tutor (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:16:40)
he teaches Da-hye to attack each test like a bulldozer, all swagger and certainty (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:17:00)
Ki-woo meets the Parks' hyperactive young son Da-song; Yeon-kyo frets over finding him an art teacher (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:17:55)
the boy Da-song tears around the house in a toy headdress, a wild little prince his mother cannot control (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:18:10)
Mrs Park confides her worry that no art teacher can handle her wild, troubled son - and Ki-woo spots his next opening (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:18:30)
Mrs Park frets over the boy's strange, frantic drawings, certain they hide some deep wound (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:19:20)
Ki-woo recommends an 'elite art therapist, Jessica' - secretly his sister Ki-jung - planting the second con (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:19:55)
Jessica diagnoses the boy's drawings as a cry for help, inventing a whole psychology on the spot (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:22:30)
she names her exorbitant fee, and the desperate mother agrees gratefully (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:26:20)
Ki-jung ('Jessica') dazzles Yeon-kyo with invented art-therapy jargon about Da-song's drawings, landing the job (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:26:40)
Mr Park personally drives Ki-jung home, polite and oblivious, as she sets her trap (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:29:00)
Mr Park (Dong-ik) has his driver take Ki-jung home; she plants her underwear under the car seat (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:29:30)
alone in the back of the chauffeured car at night, Ki-jung calmly sets her trap (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:30:00 - DARK)
the Parks find the planted underwear and assume their young driver is having sex in the car - he is fired (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:32:35)
the loyal young driver is dismissed without a hearing - in this world the poor are endlessly replaceable (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:33:40)
Ki-taek wins the job by performing the perfect calm, devoted servant Mr Park wants to see (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:37:00)
con #3 lands: Ki-taek is hired as the Parks' new chauffeur, recommended as a trustworthy older 'gentleman' (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:37:50)
the Kims learn the loyal housekeeper Moon-gwang has a hidden peach allergy and plot to exploit it (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:39:55)
the family plots the housekeeper's downfall like a heist, mapping out her one fatal weakness (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:40:30)
the Kims dust peach fuzz on Moon-gwang to trigger her allergy, then frame the reaction as tuberculosis (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:42:30)
Ki-taek convinces a frightened Yeon-kyo that Moon-gwang has TB; the last servant is ousted - all four Kims now embedded (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:44:40)
the housekeeper is cast out coughing and pleading - the last loyal servant of the house, gone (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:45:00)
all four Kims are now secretly employed by the Parks under false identities, pretending to be strangers - the con complete (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:51:30)
the Park family leaves for Da-song's birthday camping trip, emptying the house (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:53:35)
the Kims test the great empty rooms, hardly believing such space belongs to anyone (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:54:00)
the Parks' car pulls away for the camping trip, the boy's toy bow in hand (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:55:00)
alone in the mansion, the Kims sprawl in the garden and living room, drinking the Parks' whiskey (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:56:40)
the Kims lounge in the garden in the rain, and for a moment the line between servant and master seems to dissolve (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:57:30)
they soak in the rich family's bath, slipping for an evening into a life that is not theirs (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:58:30)
the Kims muse about the rich Parks and pretend the house is theirs - the class-fantasy beat (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:00:50)
Chung-sook teases that if the Parks came home now, Ki-taek would scuttle off like a cockroach - a joke that stings (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:02:00)
late at night the doorbell rings: the former housekeeper Moon-gwang returns, begging to fetch something from the basement (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:03:00)
Moon-gwang opens a hidden door behind the basement shelving, revealing a stairwell descending underground (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:05:00 - TWIST-HOLD: do not pre-leak in hook)
Moon-gwang descends the hidden stair into the dark, Chung-sook following warily behind (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:06:25 - DARK; TWIST-HOLD lead-in)

in a secret bunker beneath the house, Moon-gwang's husband Geun-sae has been hiding for years, living off the Parks unseen (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:07:00 - TWIST-HOLD: the film's central secret, hook must not spoil)
the bunker is a whole hidden world of shelves and wires and salvaged junk - a life lived entirely in the dark (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:07:30 - DARK; TWIST-HOLD)
Geun-sae, gaunt and grateful, explains he hid here to escape loan sharks - a second parasite family already inside the house (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:08:30 - TWIST-HOLD)
Moon-gwang moves through the underground room she has secretly kept her husband alive in for years (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:08:50 - DARK; TWIST-HOLD)
Down in the concrete bunker Geun-sae eats in the gloom beside a panel of blinking lights - a man who has made a home out of a tomb (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:09:50 - DARK; TWIST-HOLD)
the two poor families discover each other; Moon-gwang films the Kims and threatens to send the proof to Mrs Park - mutual blackmail (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:11:00)
The standoff turns into a scramble for the incriminating phone, the two poor families clawing at each other on the cellar floor (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:12:30)
the two families tumble down the bunker stairs locked together, all dignity gone (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:13:30)
the Kims freeze at the phone - the rich family's whim has just become their emergency (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:15:30)
the Parks phone: the rain has ended the camping trip and they are heading home in eight minutes - panic (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:15:50)
Mrs Park casually adds an order for the boy's favourite noodles, oblivious to the chaos she is driving home into (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:16:10)
the Kims overpower Moon-gwang and Geun-sae, forcing them back down into the bunker, and scramble to erase every trace (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:17:15)
the Kims sprint through the house hiding bottles, plumping cushions, scrubbing away the evidence of their stolen evening (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:17:45)
Chung-sook, the new housekeeper, cooks the boy's luxury noodles on demand while her family lies hidden under the table (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:18:30)
the Parks arrive home early; Ki-taek, Ki-woo and Ki-jung hide under the low living-room table as the family settles on the couch (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:20:00)
Trapped under the table, the Kims must lie utterly still, listening to the family's pillow talk inches above them (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:21:30)
on the couch above the hidden Kims, Mr Park complains that Ki-taek's smell 'crosses the line' - the class insult that will detonate later (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:27:30; Ki-taek hidden under table)
under the table Ki-taek hears himself reduced to a smell, and something behind his eyes goes very still (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:28:20)

the three Kims flee the Parks' house through the storm, descending the city's stairways back down toward their flooded poor district (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:31:30 - DARK; SILENCE candidate - Bong's wordless vertical descent)
the descent never seems to end - down stairs, down ramps, down into the drowning low city (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:32:10 - DARK; vertical motif)
the family descends the rain-soaked city stairways in the night flood - Bong's wordless vertical sequence (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:33:18 - SILENCE shot, atmospheric breathing room; DARK)
down and down they go through the drowning streets, the rain that delighted the rich now swallowing the poor (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:34:00 - DARK)
their semi-basement neighbourhood is drowning in the night flood; the family wades down the submerged alley (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:35:00 - DARK; SILENCE candidate)
inside, sewage erupts from the toilet; their home and belongings are destroyed by the flood (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:36:30 - DARK)
they wade through their ruined home salvaging what little the filthy water has not taken (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:37:00 - DARK)
the displaced family sleeps on the floor of a crowded gymnasium shelter among other flood refugees (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:39:30)
in the shelter Ki-taek tells his son the only foolproof plan is to have no plan at all, so nothing can go wrong (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:40:00)
in the shelter Ki-taek lies awake, a man who has run out of plans and out of hope (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:40:30)
the next day Yeon-kyo throws an impromptu garden party for Da-song; the exhausted Kims are summoned to serve (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:43:00)
Mrs Park excitedly phones round her wealthy friends to assemble the impromptu garden party (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:44:00)
summoned straight from the shelter, the Kims serve a garden full of the cheerful rich (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:45:30)
guests gather in the sunlit garden; Mr Park enlists Ki-taek in a costumed surprise for his son (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:46:00)
Mr Park dresses Ki-taek up in a feathered headdress for a children's game, the absurd costume one more small humiliation (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:47:00)
is this part of my job, Ki-taek asks quietly - and is told to think of it as extra pay (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:48:15)
Below the party, Geun-sae - starved and unhinged after his wife's death - crawls up the bunker stairs toward the light (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:51:00 - DARK)
Ki-jung carries the lit birthday cake out across the bright lawn toward the waiting guests (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:51:30)
Ki-jung carries out the birthday cake to the gathered guests - the calm an instant before the violence (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:52:05)

Geun-sae erupts from the bunker into the party and stabs Ki-jung; chaos breaks out among the guests (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:53:18 - CENSOR region blur [output-canvas coords] on the stabbing; fast-cut chaos)
Ki-taek freezes in his ridiculous costume, his daughter's blood on his hand (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:53:40 - CENSOR region on the bloody hand)
Ki-jung lies bleeding on the grass as the party scatters in terror (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:53:55 - CENSOR region blur on the wound; output-canvas coords)
blood-spattered panic in the garden as Geun-sae rampages and Chung-sook fights back (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:54:10 - CENSOR region blur [output-canvas coords] on the blood/gore; tight-but-central region)
and Mr Park, reaching for his car keys, pinches his nose shut against the dying man's smell (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:54:25)
Mr Park recoils from Geun-sae's smell; the class insult detonates and Ki-taek stabs Dong-ik dead (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:54:40 - CENSOR region blur [output-canvas coords] on the stabbing)
that one flinch is the line, crossed for the last time, and Ki-taek drives the knife home (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:55:00 - CENSOR region)
When the screaming stops, the garden is a scene of carnage - and Ki-taek is simply gone, swallowed by the crowd (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:55:30 - DARK)
Ki-woo lies bleeding in the grass as the screaming party scatters around him (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:55:50 - DARK)
in the bloodied, emptying garden the survivors are left among the wreckage of two families (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:56:15 - DARK)
in the bloody aftermath Ki-taek has vanished; Ki-jung is dead and Ki-woo gravely wounded - the family destroyed (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:56:30 - DARK)
Ki-woo survives, but the head wound leaves him laughing helplessly; he and his mother are led away under guard (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:57:00)
he wakes in a hospital bed with a wound that has left him laughing, helpless, at nothing at all (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:57:10)
Ki-woo climbs the slum stairways back up toward the house, drawn to it again and again (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:58:50)

on a snowy hillside Ki-woo watches the Park house; its lights blink in Morse code and he realises his father has taken Geun-sae's place, hiding in the bunker (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:59:05 - TWIST-HOLD: ending realisation)
weeks later: Ki-woo, recovered from a head injury, and Chung-sook are convicted of fraud; Ki-taek is still missing (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:59:20)
a quieter, scarred Ki-woo rides the subway, haunted by what happened and by his missing father (FRAME-VERIFIED 02:00:00)
He drifts through the cold city, a quieter and emptier young man than the schemer we first met (FRAME-VERIFIED 02:00:30)
He pours everything into a letter to his father - the only way left to reach a man hiding beneath a stranger's house (FRAME-VERIFIED 02:01:30 - TWIST-HOLD: ending)
every night he writes another letter into the dark, telling his father about the plan to come (FRAME-VERIFIED 02:02:00)
in the daydream he buys the house outright, and a real-estate agent simply hands him the keys (FRAME-VERIFIED 02:05:00)

Ki-woo writes a letter vowing to earn enough to buy the house so his father can simply walk up the stairs; we see the dreamed reunion (FRAME-VERIFIED 02:05:40 - TWIST-HOLD: leave as maybe-dream, do not state as achievable)

the film cuts back to the same semi-basement window and the snowy alley - Ki-woo is still here; the plan that will never fail because there is no plan (FRAME-VERIFIED 02:06:25 - SILENCE shot for the ambiguous ending; mirrors the opening)
